sentences.cn_text: 对英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）与DeepMind之间交易危险性的任何公正评估，都必须首先承认双方用意良善。
sentences.en_text: Any fair-minded assessment of the dangers of the deal between Britain’s National Health Service (NHS) and DeepMind must start by acknowledging that both sides mean well.

sentences.cn_text: DeepMind是全球领先的人工智能（AI）公司之一。
sentences.en_text: DeepMind is one of the leading artificial intelligence (AI) companies in the world.

sentences.cn_text: 这项工作应用于医疗保健领域的潜力极为巨大，但它也可能导致权力进一步集中于科技巨头手中。
sentences.en_text: The potential of this work applied to healthcare is very great, but it could also lead to further concentration of power in the tech giants.

sentences.cn_text: 正是在这一背景下，信息专员伊丽莎白·德纳姆对NHS下属的皇家自由医院信托做出了严厉裁决，该医院在2015年根据一项模糊协议，将160万名患者的记录交给了DeepMind，而该协议对患者权利和隐私期望考虑严重不足。
sentences.en_text: It is against that background that the information commissioner, Elizabeth Denham, has issued her damning verdict against the Royal Free hospital trust under the NHS, which handed over to DeepMind the records of 1.6 million patients in 2015 on the basis of a vague agreement which took far too little account of the patients’ rights and their expectations of privacy.

sentences.cn_text: DeepMind几乎表示了歉意。
sentences.en_text: DeepMind has almost apologized.

sentences.cn_text: NHS信托已改正其做法。
sentences.en_text: The NHS trust has mended its ways.

sentences.cn_text: NHS与DeepMind之间未来的进一步安排——可能会有很多——将受到严格审查，以确保已获得患者的所有必要许可，并清除所有不必要的数据。
sentences.en_text: Further arrangements — and there may be many — between the NHS and DeepMind will be carefully scrutinised to ensure that all necessary permissions have been asked of patients and all unnecessary data has been cleaned.

sentences.cn_text: 关于知情患者同意，仍有许多教训需要汲取。
sentences.en_text: There are lessons about informed patient consent to learn.

sentences.cn_text: 但隐私并非本案中的唯一角度，甚至不是最重要的角度。
sentences.en_text: But privacy is not the only angle in this case and not even the most important.

sentences.cn_text: 德纳姆女士选择将责任集中归咎于NHS信托，因为根据现行法律，它「控制」数据，而DeepMind仅仅「处理」数据。
sentences.en_text: Ms Denham chose to concentrate the blame on the NHS trust, since under existing law it “controlled” the data and DeepMind merely “processed” it.

tokens.gloss: 英国国家医疗服务体系

sentences.cn_text: 但这一区分忽略了一个关键点：赋予数据价值的是处理和聚合，而非仅仅拥有数据片段。
sentences.en_text: But this distinction misses the point that it is processing and aggregation, not the mere possession of bits, that gives the data value.

sentences.cn_text: 关键问题在于，谁应该从我们生活所产生的所有数据的分析中获益。
sentences.en_text: The great question is who should benefit from the analysis of all the data that our lives now generate.

sentences.cn_text: 隐私法建立在这样的概念之上：个人因关于其自身的可识别信息而遭受损害。
sentences.en_text: Privacy law builds on the concept of damage to an individual from identifiable knowledge about them.

sentences.cn_text: 这忽视了监控经济的运作方式。
sentences.en_text: That misses the way the surveillance economy works.

sentences.cn_text: 个人数据只有在与无数其他人的数据进行比对时，才具备价值。
sentences.en_text: The data of an individual there gains its value only when it is compared with the data of countless millions more.

sentences.cn_text: 在此情况下，运用隐私法来约束科技巨头的做法显得略微不合时宜。
sentences.en_text: The use of privacy law to curb the tech giants in this instance feels slightly maladapted.

sentences.cn_text: 这种做法并未触及真正的忧虑所在。
sentences.en_text: This practice does not address the real worry.

sentences.cn_text: 仅仅说DeepMind开发的算法将造福患者并挽救生命是不够的。
sentences.en_text: It is not enough to say that the algorithms DeepMind develops will benefit patients and save lives.

sentences.cn_text: 关键在于，这些算法将归属于一家利用公共资源开发它们的私人垄断企业。
sentences.en_text: What matters is that they will belong to a private monopoly which developed them using public resources.

sentences.cn_text: 如果软件有望像药物现在所能达到的那样大规模拯救生命，那么大数据可能会如同大型制药公司那样行事。
sentences.en_text: If software promises to save lives on the scale that drugs now can, big data may be expected to behave as a big pharma has done.

sentences.cn_text: 我们仍处于这场变革的起点，如今的微小抉择可能在未来造成巨大后果。
sentences.en_text: We are still at the beginning of this revolution and small choices now may turn out to have gigantic consequences later.

sentences.cn_text: 为避免数字封建主义的未来，需要进行长期抗争。
sentences.en_text: A long struggle will be needed to avoid a future of digital feudalism.

sentences.cn_text: 德纳姆女士的报告是一个令人欣慰的开端。
sentences.en_text: Ms Denham’s report is a welcome start.

sentences.cn_text: 关于NHS与DeepMind之间的协议，下列哪项正确？
sentences.en_text: What is true of the agreement between the NHS and DeepMind?

sentences.cn_text: 它在科技巨头间引发了冲突。
sentences.en_text: It caused conflicts among tech giants.

sentences.cn_text: 它未能对患者权利给予应有的关注。
sentences.en_text: It failed to pay due attention to patients’ rights.

sentences.cn_text: 它未能达到后者的期望。
sentences.en_text: It fell short of the latter’s expectations.

sentences.cn_text: 它使双方陷入危险境地。
sentences.en_text: It put both sides into a dangerous situation.

sentences.cn_text: NHS信托对德纳姆的裁决做出了____回应。
sentences.en_text: The NHS trust responded to Denham’s verdict with ____

sentences.cn_text: 空洞的承诺。
sentences.en_text: empty promises.

sentences.cn_text: 强硬的抵抗。
sentences.en_text: tough resistance.

sentences.cn_text: 必要的调整。
sentences.en_text: necessary adjustments.

sentences.cn_text: 真诚的道歉。
sentences.en_text: sincere apologies.

sentences.cn_text: 作者在第2段中主张____
sentences.en_text: The author argues in Paragraph 2 that ____

sentences.cn_text: 必须不惜一切代价保障隐私保护。
sentences.en_text: privacy protection must be secured at all costs.

sentences.cn_text: 泄露患者数据比出售它更为恶劣。
sentences.en_text: leaking patients’ data is worse than selling it.

sentences.cn_text: 从患者数据中牟利属于非法行为。
sentences.en_text: making profits from patients’ data is illegal.

sentences.cn_text: 数据的价值源于对其的处理。
sentences.en_text: the value of data comes from the processing of it.

sentences.cn_text: 根据最后一段，这笔交易引发的真正担忧是____
sentences.en_text: According to the last paragraph, the real worry arising from this deal is ____

sentences.cn_text: 大型制药公司之间的恶性竞争。
sentences.en_text: the vicious rivalry among big pharmas.

sentences.cn_text: 隐私法的执行不力。
sentences.en_text: the ineffective enforcement of privacy law.

sentences.cn_text: 新软件的失控使用。
sentences.en_text: the uncontrolled use of new software.

sentences.cn_text: 科技巨头对大数据的垄断。
sentences.en_text: the monopoly of big data by tech giants.

sentences.cn_text: 作者对人工智能在医疗保健领域应用的态度是____
sentences.en_text: The author’s attitude toward the application of AI to healthcare is ____

sentences.cn_text: 模棱两可的。
sentences.en_text: ambiguous.

sentences.cn_text: 谨慎的。
sentences.en_text: cautious.

sentences.cn_text: 赞赏的。
sentences.en_text: appreciative.

sentences.cn_text: 轻蔑的。
sentences.en_text: contemptuous.
